description: Free PHP language server: completion, type inference, navigation and include-aware analysis for modern and legacy PHP.
phpForge.restartServer.title: Restart Language Server
phpForge.reindex.title: Reindex Workspace
phpForge.showOutput.title: Show Output
phpForge.exclude.description: Glob patterns (relative to the workspace folder) of files and folders that are neither indexed nor analyzed, e.g. `**/cache/**`.
phpForge.maxFileSize.description: Files larger than this size, in bytes, are ignored.
phpForge.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the PHP Forge language server.
phpForge.phpVersion.description: PHP version of the project, e.g. `7.3`: completion only offers what exists in this version. Empty: read from `composer.json`, then from the `php` executable, otherwise 8.3.
phpForge.stubs.description: PHP extensions whose native functions, classes and constants are known (folder names of JetBrains phpstorm-stubs).
phpForge.inlayHints.parameterNames.descr: Show parameter names before literal arguments.
phpForge.inlayHints.variableTypes.descri: Show the inferred type of assigned variables.
phpForge.inlayHints.returnTypes.descript: Show the inferred return type of functions without a declared type.
phpForge.documentRoot.description: Web root used for `$_SERVER['DOCUMENT_ROOT']` in include paths: absolute, or relative to the workspace folder. Empty: the workspace folder.
phpForge.serverRoot.description: Absolute path of the site on the server, so that includes written with server paths (`/var/www/site/inc/x.php`) are found locally. Empty: the `remotePath` of `.vscode/deploy.json` profiles.
phpForge.includes.maxContexts.descriptio: Number of different include contexts analyzed per file. Beyond that, the analysis of the file is approximate.
phpForge.externalGlobals.description: Variables defined outside the analyzed code (`auto_prepend_file`, framework), never reported as undefined, e.g. `$config`.
phpForge.showIncludeTree.title: Show Include Tree
phpForge.showIncluders.title: Show Files Including This File
phpForge.includeTree.name: Include Tree
